description: Pajek .net / .paj / .tim / .mat: igraph's unit and regression files, the Pajek multinet teaching data, Batagelj's datasets (USAir97, divorce, Tina) and a broad sample of the bavla/Nets mirror of the Pajek datasets, networkx 3.1 writer output, and authored encoding and syntax cases. Expectations: networkx 3.1 read_pajek for single-section files, else a counter written from the Pajek 6.02 manual (tools/oracle_pajek.py); the right behaviour of sources.md section 6.4 and the owner decisions (first network plus W_MULTIPLE_GRAPHS; encoding: BOM, else option, else UTF-8, else windows-1252 with W_ENCODING_FALLBACK).
